name: Chainbreaker's Tenacity
rulesText: Chosen allied unit gets +1 power until end of turn and gains 2 armor.

name: Tactical Withdrawal
rulesText: Return up to one chosen allied unit to its owner's hand. Draw a card.

name: Blindside
rulesText: Chosen opposing unit gets -3 power until the end of your opponent's turn.

name: Devilhorn Scouting Party
rulesText: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may deploy a unit card with Requisition cost 3 or less from among them for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, Scratch 1.

name: Improvised Orders
rulesText: Draw 3 cards, then discard a card.

name: Pincer Tactics
rulesText: Deal 1 damage to each of up to 2 chosen allied units. Deal 2 damage to chosen non-Scratch asset.

name: Poisoned Rations
rulesText: Chosen unit gets -3 max health until end of turn.

name: Reaver's Rush
rulesText: Deploy chosen unit card with power 3 or less from your discard pile for free.

name: Allshan's Battle Trance
rulesText: Deploy chosen unit card from your discard pile to the Main Theater. It gains Stalwart and gets +2 power until end of turn.

name: Ambush Tactics
rulesText:
Choose two:
- Kill chosen unit.
- Return chosen unit to its owner's hand.
- Chosen unit deals damage equal to its power to another chosen unit.
- Put chosen unit on top of its owner's deck.

name: Steel Rain
rulesText:
As an additional cost to enact this maneuver, discard up to 3 cards.
For each card discarded this way, deal 2 damage to chosen asset.
Then, if you have no cards in hand, draw 2 cards.
